scripts.dev:hot:reset: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.hotreload.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.hotreload.yml up
scripts.dev:setup: pnpm install && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' build && cd apps/api && npx prisma generate
scripts.migrate: pnpm --filter migrator build && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter migrator start:prod
scripts.dev:local: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n api,web,ai,worker -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter ai dev" "pnpm --filter worker dev"
